Scaling up next-token prediction based on web text data is hitting a wall. What if a time traveler told you that, by November 2026... • AI models would have human-like fluid intelligence, thanks to a new paradigm: test-time induction (modern reasoning models). • Not only would ARC 1 be saturated, but unreleased benchmarks 10x harder (ARC 2) and 100x harder (ARC 3) would be saturated too. • Nearly all code would be written by AI, and models could one-shot complex codebases flawlessly. • AI models would be solving multiple Millennium Prize problems. • OpenAI's valuation would be 15x higher, and Anthropic's would be 85x higher. And on top of all that... • Nvidia would still hold ~80% of the AI compute market. • Nvidia would have grown its revenue and earnings 4.5x. • Nvidia would still be growing 75% a year. • Nvidia would have even higher operating margins (67% vs. 65% back then). Based on that information, straight from the future, would you have bought NVDA? If you answered yes -- congrats. Today, 2.5 years later, you'd be down 5% on your investment (even more after inflation).
